title: Road Widening, Maharlika Highway, Labo, Camarines Norte (1St Legislative District)
description: ORGANIZATIONAL OUTCOME 1 : ENSURE SAFE AND RELIABLE NATIONAL ROAD SYSTEM - NETWORK DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM - ROAD WIDENING - PRIMARY ROADS - MAHARLIKA HIGHWAY - K0295 + 000 - K0295 + 180, LABO, CAMARINES NORTE (1ST LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT)
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.
contractor: Golden Tiller Construction and Supply (winning bidder)

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱141.8M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Road widening, 229 past contracts) is ₱98.0M per km. Length read from the title: 180 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

tests.text: Only one bidder at award (linked to late completion and to citizen-reported problems in past contracts)
